title: PortalNode-01 — Fully Assembled System in Rack
caption: PortalNode-01 fully assembled in data rack
prompt: Create a photorealistic, technical 3D engineering illustration of the fully assembled PortalNode-01 system installed in a standard 19-inch data center rack. The main focus is a 4U server (standard ATX form factor, with visible consumer-grade cues like RTX 4090 Founders Edition GPU cards through a vented matte silver front panel) positioned at eye level. The server chassis is finished in deep navy (#1a1a2e) with matte silver (#c0c0c0) accents, and subtle emerald (#00b894) highlights on active components. Status LEDs are visible on the server’s front panel: a steady green LED for power, blue for GPU activity, and amber for network. Above and below the server, blank rack panels (matte silver) suggest modular expansion space, hinting at a future Node B. At the bottom of the rack, include a compact rack-mounted UPS with visible power connectors and subtle amber highlights indicating power/thermal paths. All cabling is meticulously managed: thick black power cables routed vertically down the left side, blue and amber network cables down the right, secured with cable combs and clips. Suggest airflow direction with subtle, semi-transparent arrows or vent patterns, emphasizing enterprise-level cooling. The entire rack sits against a neutral dark gray gradient background, evoking a data center environment. Lighting is clean, even, and studio-like, with soft reflections on metallic surfaces. The overall impression is of a robust, production-ready, HIPAA-compliant inference appliance, built from consumer hardware but packaged for enterprise reliability. No people or text overlays.
